title: The Effect of S616L, a CPVT1-Associated Mutation, on the Stability and Structure of Human Cardiac RyR2.
authors: Bauer, Jacob A; Benko, Mario; Sutova, Lubica; Beck, Konrad; Nowak, Jakub; Bellova, Jana; Barath, Peter; Bauerova-Hlinkova, Vladena
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟研究CPVT1相关S616L突变对人心脏RyR2蛋白N端结构域稳定性和结构的影响，属于蛋白质结构计算建模课题。
abstract: Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia type 1 (CPVT1) is a heritable genetic disease caused by mutations to hRyR2, the cardiac isoform of the human ryanodine receptor. One such mutation, S616L, is found in the alpha-helical part (NSol) of the hRyR2 N-terminal domain (NTD) close to a three-way junction between the NTD, junctional solenoid (JSol), and bridging solenoid (BSol) domains. In this study, we use molecular dynamics simulation to study the effect of S616L on the residues of this junction. We find that the mutation slightly weakens the interface between the N-terminal domain and the bridging solenoid by changing the preferred conformation of the residues at the interface, thereby promoting a slight opening between these domains. In addition, we determined the impact of this mutation on the biophysical and biochemical properties of a 655-residue fragment containing the entire hRyR2 N-terminal domain, finding that it slightly increases the thermal stability of the fragment.
abstract_zh: 儿茶酚胺能多形性室性心动过速1型（CPVT1）是一种由hRyR2（人类兰尼碱受体的心脏亚型）突变引起的遗传性疾病。其中一种突变S616L位于hRyR2 N端结构域（NTD）的α-螺旋部分（NSol），靠近NTD、连接性螺线管（JSol）和桥接性螺线管（BSol）结构域之间的三向连接处。在本研究中，我们利用分子动力学模拟来研究S616L对该连接处残基的影响。我们发现，该突变通过改变界面处残基的优选构象，轻微削弱了N端结构域与桥接性螺线管之间的界面，从而促进了这些结构域之间的轻微开放。此外，我们确定了该突变对包含整个hRyR2 N端结构域的655残基片段的生物物理和生化特性的影响，发现它略微增加了该片段的热稳定性。
